cards.name: Barrel Dragon
cards.officialEffect: Once per turn: You can toss a coin 3 times. If 2 or more results are heads, destroy 1 monster your opponent controls.

cards.name: Blowback Dragon
cards.officialEffect: Once per turn: You can toss a coin 3 times. If 2 or more results are heads, destroy 1 card on the field.

behavior: Each activation consumes exactly three values from the persisted HMAC-SHA256 duel random stream; no Math.random fallback.
At least two heads succeeds; zero or one head resolves without a destruction prompt.
Barrel Dragon offers only affectable monsters controlled by the opposing team, including its inactive partner.
Blowback Dragon offers affectable monsters, Spell/Trap Zone cards and the independent Field Zone on either team.
The target is chosen only after a successful coin result; stale target UIDs are rejected and current options are revalidated.
Destruction uses sendMonsterToGrave/discardBackrow, preserving physical monster ownership, grave triggers, equip cleanup and card lifetimes.
Soft once-per-turn use is spent on effect resolution; activation negation releases the flag, effect negation does not.
No automatic discard: hands above six remain unchanged until the End Phase.
limitations: Adapter isolado: não altera effectRegistry, resolver central, catálogo, certificações, allowlist, comandos, banco ou dados persistentes de jogadores.
Os testes usam IDs físicos já certificados como fixtures e injetam a identidade mecânica por lookup; os passcodes reais continuam fora do catálogo.
O host deve encaminhar a janela de ativação/negação e persistir a sessão + contador HMAC atomicamente; o adapter não executa o gateway Discord.
Não há merge, deploy ou validação de produção.
